title: Diagonal compass draws land up to √2·span from the router, so the documented [GROWTH_OUT_MIN, connect_span] annulus and 'E31 by construction' claim overstate — enforcement actually rests on the growth_connectable rejection check, and ~half the attempt budget can sample guaranteed-reject positions
detail: 4 of 8 directions are diagonal; at dist near span the Euclidean offset is √2·span ≈ 1.414·span, outside the picked router's radius, so those candidates only survive via the explicit rejection check — burning GROWTH_MAX_ATTEMPTS budget and biasing spawns cardinally. E31 itself still holds; determinism unaffected.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment (drop 'E31 by construction' — the connectable check is the enforcement), or clamp the distance draw for diagonal dirs (e.g. hi scaled by span·1/√2 integer approx) so the sampled annulus matches the documented bias; no golden-safe change without re-bless.
